scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: At [13:38], the agent ended the call saying 'Take care, bye now' and omitted the mandatory closing brand phrase 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Although the customer introduced herself as Orlaith at [00:09], the agent never used the customer's name 'Orlaith' at any point during the call.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [04:44], the agent deflected responsibility to a third-party agency by stating that Blackhawk runs the promotion, that it is 'not our department', and that the customer would have to email their claims desk herself.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At [06:18], the agent made a dismissive and unprofessional remark ('I really don't know why customers expect technical and billing support to chase affiliate gift cards').

grader.scenario: Promotional £75 prepaid reward card never arrived 60 days after activating S-Net Fibre 300
grader.notes: Okay call with 4 FAILs (B, P, O, R). Agent Harriet opens with proper S-Net branding at [00:00], empathizes at [00:21], paraphrases at [00:44], verifies address and PIN at [01:09], and probes thoroughly into the Uswitch referral. However, she never uses the customer's name 'Orlaith' (P FAIL), deflects blame to third-party agency Blackhawk at [04:44] (O FAIL), makes a dismissive remark about customers at [06:18] (R FAIL), and omits the closing brand phrase at [13:38] (B FAIL). After Orlaith pushes back, Harriet voids the voucher during a managed hold ([08:06]–[09:22]) and applies a direct £75 bill credit, which Orlaith confirms live in her My S-Net app at [11:24] (RE PASS).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good morning, thank you for calling S-Net Customer Support.' (greeting present); [13:38] Agent: 'Take care, bye now.' (missing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in last 4 turns).

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [08:06] Agent: 'May I place you on a brief hold while I void the external Blackhawk claim ID...' -> [09:22] Agent: 'Thank you for holding.'

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [01:09] Agent asks for full postal address and four-digit security PIN; [01:21] Customer confirms 19 Meadowbank Crescent and PIN 4829.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:09] Customer states her name is Orlaith, but zero Agent turns contain 'Orlaith'.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:21] Agent: 'I am really sorry to hear that your seventy-five pound prepaid reward card still hasn't come through after two months, as I completely understand how frustrating it is waiting on a sign-up incentive you were promised.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [00:44] Agent: 'So just to make sure I have the full picture, you activated your S-Net Fibre 300 package around sixty days ago under the promotional seventy-five pound prepaid MasterCard offer, and you have not received the card or claim link yet, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent accurately tracks the Uswitch reference USW-994182-SN, August 5 order date, and August 14 installation date without asking the customer to repeat any details.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [04:44] Agent: 'Look, the third-party voucher fulfilment agency Blackhawk runs that reward card promotion, that's not our department and you'd normally have to email their claims desk yourself.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [06:18] Agent: 'I really don't know why customers expect technical and billing support to chase affiliate gift cards.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:43] Agent probes whether the order was placed via a comparison site; [02:09] Agent probes for the affiliate registration reference, installation date, and spam folder checks.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [09:22] Agent voids the stuck voucher and applies a direct £75.00 bill credit (ADJ-884920); [11:24] Customer refreshes her My S-Net page and confirms '-£75.00' credit balance is live.
